description: Reviews the GoLive plan executions that carry an explicit destructive or live confirmation flag. GoLive already refuses account writes without an approved plan id, recomputes that plan's identity before running, and deletes only resources it recorded as its own; the confirmation flags themselves are passed by the caller on the human's behalf, so `golive apply` with --confirm-destroy, --confirm-live or --confirm-dns is where an independent review adds something. The read-only surface (`golive help`, `version`, `update-check`, `detect`, `menu`, `doctor`, `plan`, `teardown`, `verify`, `status`, `handoff`) is outside these rules: `teardown` is the inverse plan and deletes nothing, and `plan` is what prints the plan id a human approves.
name: GoLive deployment CLI protection
saferAlternatives: Review the intent first: `golive teardown` prints the inverse plan of the resources golive itself created and deletes nothing, `golive plan` prints the plan id to approve and is read-only, and `golive status`, `golive handoff`, `golive verify` and `golive doctor` only read state and providers. Ask the human to approve the plan id, then run `golive apply --plan <id> --yes` with the confirmation flag only when they gave that specific approval.
